$comment: Single source of truth for the Tlumach file templates offered by the editor integrations.
Consumed by src/Extension.VisualStudio (Add New Item templates) and src/Extension.VSCode
(the 'Tlumach: New Translation File' / 'Tlumach: New Configuration File' commands).
The extensions and the formats registered by the parsers in src/Tlumach.Base must stay in sync:
translation extensions come from FileFormats.RegisterParser, configuration extensions come from

tokens.$fileinputname$: The name the user typed, without an extension.
tokens.$rootnamespace$: The default namespace of the project the file is added to.

formats.name: JSON
formats.description: Tlumach translation file in the simple JSON format.

formats.name: ARB
formats.description: Tlumach translation file in the ARB (Application Resource Bundle) format.

formats.name: INI
formats.description: Tlumach translation file in the INI format.

formats.name: TOML
formats.description: Tlumach translation file in the TOML format.

formats.name: CSV
formats.description: Tlumach translation file in the CSV format; one column per locale.

formats.name: TSV
formats.description: Tlumach translation file in the TSV format; one column per locale.

formats.name: XLIFF
formats.description: Tlumach translation file in the XLIFF 2.x bitext format; one source/target language pair per file.

formats.name: Apple String Catalog
formats.description: Tlumach translation file in the Apple String Catalog format; all locales live in one file.

formats.name: ResX
formats.description: Tlumach translation file in the ResX format. The name carries a duplicate .resx extension and the item is marked Non-Resx so that the .NET toolchain embeds the file verbatim instead of compiling it into a satellite assembly.

formats.name: INI
formats.description: Tlumach configuration file in the INI format.

formats.name: JSON
formats.description: Tlumach configuration file in the JSON format.

formats.name: TOML
formats.description: Tlumach configuration file in the TOML format.

formats.name: ARB
formats.description: Tlumach configuration file in the ARB (JSON) format.

formats.name: ResX
formats.description: Tlumach configuration file in the XML format used with ResX translations.

formats.name: XLIFF
formats.description: Tlumach configuration file in the XML format used with XLIFF translations.
